# Dashboard block

> KPIs, charts and tables together.

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-ai-docs.mjs (npm run gen:ai). Do not edit by hand. -->

Install doc for the **Dashboard block** of ui-kit: 3 variants built only from ui-kit components. React >=18.2 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4.

## Instructions for the AI agent

Add the Dashboard block to this project exactly as specified here. If the user did not say which variant, ask, or install the first one.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Install these components first**, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Follow each one's doc, or run the download script below, which covers all of them:
   - `avatar`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/avatar.md
   - `badge`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/badge.md
   - `button`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/button.md
   - `card`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/card.md
   - `chart`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/chart.md
   - `checkbox`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/checkbox.md
   - `popover`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/popover.md
   - `dropdown-menu`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/dropdown-menu.md
   - `field`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/field.md
   - `input`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/input.md
   - `native-select`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/native-select.md
   - `skeleton`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/skeleton.md
   - `table`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/table.md
   - `data-table`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/data-table.md
   - `progress`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/progress.md
   - `stat`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/stat.md
   - `timeline`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/timeline.md
   - `toggle-group`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/toggle-group.md
   - `usage-meter`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/usage-meter.md
3. **Shared files.** Create the files under [Shared files](#shared-files) at their exact paths (the download script covers them).
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/avatar.css";
   @import "./components/badge.css";
   @import "./components/button.css";
   @import "./components/card.css";
   @import "./components/chart.css";
   @import "./components/checkbox.css";
   @import "./components/popover.css";
   @import "./components/dropdown-menu.css";
   @import "./components/field.css";
   @import "./components/input.css";
   @import "./components/native-select.css";
   @import "./components/skeleton.css";
   @import "./components/table.css";
   @import "./components/data-table.css";
   @import "./components/progress.css";
   @import "./components/stat.css";
   @import "./components/timeline.css";
   @import "./components/toggle-group.css";
   @import "./components/usage-meter.css";
   ```

5. **Create the block.** Save the variant verbatim as its own file, for example `components/blocks/dashboard/<variant>.tsx` inside the `@/` folder, then render it from a page. Change the copy (names, prices, links) only if the user asks.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Block: Dashboard

A product dashboard page built only from library components: KPIs, charts, a table and a feed in bordered cards. Calm and professional: neutral surfaces, one accent per chart, numbers that line up. Each variant is one self-contained file with its own deterministic sample data (no `Math.random`, so server and browser render the same numbers).

#### Variants
- **Analytics overview** (`analytics`): page header with a 7 / 30 / 90 day `SegmentedControl` and an Export button; a shared `StatGroup` of four KPIs (revenue, orders, visitors, conversion) each with a `StatDelta` against the previous period and a `Sparkline`; an `AreaChart` of daily revenue vs the previous period; a horizontal `BarChart` of revenue by channel; a `DataTable` of recent orders (5 per page, no column menu); an activity `Timeline`. The range drives every number.
- **Sales and operations** (`sales`): region `SegmentedControl` (All, Americas, EMEA, APAC) that rescales every figure; a separate `StatGroup` with help text; a semicircle `RadialChart` for quota attainment with Closed / Commit / Best case under it; a `DonutChart` of ARR by plan; four `UsageMeter`s (one in warning, one destructive); a stacked `BarChart` of bookings by month; a rep leaderboard of `Avatar` + `Progress`.
- **Compact cards** (`compact`): four small KPI cards (16px padding, icon in `CardAction`, value + coloured delta text + area sparkline); an error-budget ring (`RadialChart`); busiest endpoints with `Progress` bars; latest deploys with status `Badge`s. No state and no function props, so it renders as a Server Component.

#### Anatomy
```
div.@container.w-full
  div.grid.gap-4 (@2xl:gap-6)
    header row        flex wrap, items-end, justify-between: h2 (20px/600) + muted 14px context | controls
    StatGroup         KPIs, wraps by width (min 13rem per stat)
    chart row         grid → @4xl:grid-cols-3 (wide chart col-span-2)
    detail row        grid → @4xl:grid-cols-5 (table col-span-3, feed col-span-2)
      Card.min-w-0 > CardHeader (CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction?) + CardContent
```

#### Visual rules
- Cards: `Card` defaults (1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-xl`, 20px padding, no shadow). Compact variant: `[--ui-card-padding:1rem]`, gap 8–12px.
- Gaps: 16px, 24px from a 42rem container up.
- Colour: the series that matters is `series-1`; the previous period uses `var(--ui-muted-foreground)`; status colours only for status (badges, deltas, usage thresholds).
- Numbers: `tabular-nums`, formatted with `Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', …)` (currency without cents for totals, compact for large figures); dates with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in UTC.
- Deltas always carry a comparison ("vs previous period", "vs Q3"); set `tone` when down is good.
- Chart heights: 260px main charts, 240px donut, 170px semicircle, 32–40px sparklines.

#### Responsive
- Container queries (`@container` on the block root), never viewport breakpoints: the block sits next to a sidebar.
- Every grid child has `min-w-0` so tables and charts can shrink; `DataTable` scrolls sideways inside its card.
- No horizontal page overflow at 360px; header controls wrap under the title.

#### Accessibility
- Page title is an `h2` (the app owns the `h1`); card titles are `h3`.
- Every `Sparkline` has an `aria-label` describing the series; charts render their own screen-reader table.
- `SegmentedControl` is a radio group with an `aria-label` ("Date range", "Region").
- Lists (reps, endpoints, deploys) are `ul` with an `aria-label`; each `Progress` names what it measures.

#### Acceptance checks
- Changing the range / region updates KPIs, deltas, sparklines and charts together, with the charts' smooth transition.
- At 360px nothing overflows the page; at 1024px+ the chart row shows two cards side by side.
- Light and dark both read calmly: no colour except data and status.

## Variants

Imports are rewritten from the package to the local files (`@/ui/...`).

### Analytics overview

```tsx
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/ui/components/card';
import { AreaChart, BarChart, Sparkline } from '@/ui/components/chart';
import { DataTable, type DataTableColumn } from '@/ui/components/data-table';
import { Stat, StatChart, StatDelta, StatGroup, StatLabel, StatValue } from '@/ui/components/stat';
import { Timeline, TimelineDescription, TimelineHeader, TimelineItem, TimelineTime, TimelineTitle } from '@/ui/components/timeline';
import { SegmentedControl, SegmentedControlItem } from '@/ui/components/toggle-group';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

type Range = '7d' | '30d' | '90d';
const DAYS: Record<Range, number> = { '7d': 7, '30d': 30, '90d': 90 };

// 180 days ending 24 Nov 2026: enough for the longest range and the period before it.
// Deterministic (no Math.random), so the server and the browser render the same numbers.
const daily = Array.from({ length: 180 }, (_, i) => {
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 24 - 179 + i));
  const weekend = date.getUTCDay() === 0 || date.getUTCDay() === 6;
  const wave = 1 + Math.sin(i / 6) * 0.08 + Math.sin(i / 17) * 0.05;
  const visitors = Math.round((2100 + i * 9) * wave * (weekend ? 0.74 : 1));
  const orders = Math.round(visitors * (0.026 + Math.cos(i / 11) * 0.002));
  return { date: date.toISOString().slice(0, 10), visitors, orders, revenue: Math.round(orders * (84 + (i % 9))) };
});

type Day = (typeof daily)[number];
type Metric = 'revenue' | 'orders' | 'visitors';

const sum = (rows: Day[], key: Metric) => rows.reduce((total, row) => total + row[key], 0);
const change = (now: number, before: number) => ((now - before) / before) * 100;

const money = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
const cents = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' });
const count = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US');
const shortDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });
const day = (v: string | number) => shortDate.format(new Date(`${v}T00:00:00Z`));

const channels = [
  { channel: 'Organic search', share: 0.36 },
  { channel: 'Direct', share: 0.24 },
  { channel: 'Email', share: 0.17 },
  { channel: 'Paid social', share: 0.14 },
  { channel: 'Referral', share: 0.09 },
];

type OrderStatus = 'paid' | 'processing' | 'shipped' | 'refunded';
interface Order {
  id: string;
  customer: string;
  email: string;
  product: string;
  status: OrderStatus;
  date: string;
  total: number;
}

const people = ['Amara Okafor', 'Liam Brennan', 'Sofia Marchetti', 'Noah Fischer', 'Yuki Tanaka', 'Priya Raman', 'Mateo Alvarez', 'Elena Petrova', 'Jonas Lindqvist', 'Hana Kim'];
const products = ['Linen throw', 'Oak side table', 'Ceramic vase set', 'Wool rug 160 × 230', 'Pendant lamp', 'Walnut wall shelf'];
const statuses: OrderStatus[] = ['paid', 'shipped', 'processing', 'paid', 'shipped', 'refunded', 'paid', 'processing'];

const orders: Order[] = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => {
  const customer = people[(i * 3) % people.length];
  return {
    id: `#${4821 - i}`,
    customer,
    email: `${customer.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, '.')}@example.com`,
    product: products[(i * 5) % products.length],
    status: statuses[i % statuses.length],
    date: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 24 - Math.floor(i / 3))).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    total: 48 + ((i * 7919) % 46000) / 100,
  };
});

const tone = { paid: 'success', shipped: 'info', processing: 'warning', refunded: 'secondary' } as const;
const capitalise = (s: string) => s[0].toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);

const columns: DataTableColumn<Order>[] = [
  {
    id: 'customer',
    header: 'Customer',
    accessor: 'customer',
    sortable: true,
    searchText: (row) => `${row.id} ${row.customer} ${row.email} ${row.product}`,
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <div className="grid leading-tight">
        <span className="font-medium">{row.customer}</span>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {row.id} · {row.product}
        </span>
      </div>
    ),
  },
  {
    id: 'status',
    header: 'Status',
    accessor: 'status',
    sortable: true,
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <Badge variant={tone[row.status]} dot>
        {capitalise(row.status)}
      </Badge>
    ),
  },
  { id: 'date', header: 'Date', accessor: 'date', sortable: true, cell: ({ row }) => day(row.date) },
  {
    id: 'total',
    header: 'Total',
    accessor: 'total',
    sortable: true,
    align: 'right',
    cell: ({ row }) => <span className="tabular-nums">{cents.format(row.total)}</span>,
  },
];

const activity = [
  { tone: 'success', icon: 'circle-check', title: 'Payout of $12,480 sent', time: '2026-11-24T14:10', at: '2:10 pm', text: 'Deposited to the account ending 4410.' },
  { tone: 'warning', icon: 'triangle-alert', title: 'Low stock: Pendant lamp', time: '2026-11-24T11:42', at: '11:42 am', text: '6 left. At the current rate it sells out in 3 days.' },
  { tone: 'info', icon: 'mail', title: 'Black Friday email sent', time: '2026-11-24T09:00', at: '9:00 am', text: '18,240 recipients, 41% opened so far.' },
  { tone: 'destructive', icon: 'circle-x', title: 'Refund issued for #4816', time: '2026-11-23T16:25', at: 'Yesterday', text: 'Damaged in transit. Replacement shipped.' },
  { tone: 'default', icon: 'users', title: 'Tomás Herrera joined the team', time: '2026-11-23T10:05', at: 'Yesterday', text: 'Role: Support, with access to orders.' },
] as const;

function Kpi({
  label,
  value,
  delta,
  goodWhenDown,
  series,
  color,
  variant = 'area',
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  delta: number;
  goodWhenDown?: boolean;
  series: number[];
  color: string;
  variant?: 'area' | 'line' | 'bar';
}) {
  const up = delta >= 0;
  return (
    <Stat>
      <StatLabel>{label}</StatLabel>
      <StatValue>{value}</StatValue>
      <StatDelta
        value={`${Math.abs(delta).toFixed(1)}%`}
        direction={up ? 'up' : 'down'}
        tone={up !== Boolean(goodWhenDown) ? 'positive' : 'negative'}
        comparison="vs previous period"
      />
      <StatChart>
        <Sparkline data={series} variant={variant} height={32} color={color} aria-label={`${label}, daily`} />
      </StatChart>
    </Stat>
  );
}

export default function DashboardAnalytics() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState<Range>('30d');

  const view = useMemo(() => {
    const n = DAYS[range];
    const now = daily.slice(-n);
    const before = daily.slice(-2 * n, -n);
    const revenue = sum(now, 'revenue');
    const orderCount = sum(now, 'orders');
    const visitors = sum(now, 'visitors');
    const conversion = (orderCount / visitors) * 100;
    const conversionBefore = (sum(before, 'orders') / sum(before, 'visitors')) * 100;
    return {
      revenue,
      orderCount,
      visitors,
      conversion,
      deltas: {
        revenue: change(revenue, sum(before, 'revenue')),
        orders: change(orderCount, sum(before, 'orders')),
        visitors: change(visitors, sum(before, 'visitors')),
        conversion: change(conversion, conversionBefore),
      },
      trend: now.map((row, i) => ({ date: row.date, current: row.revenue, previous: before[i].revenue })),
      spark: {
        revenue: now.map((r) => r.revenue),
        orders: now.map((r) => r.orders),
        visitors: now.map((r) => r.visitors),
        conversion: now.map((r) => (r.orders / r.visitors) * 100),
      },
      channels: channels.map((c) => ({ channel: c.channel, revenue: Math.round(revenue * c.share) })),
    };
  }, [range]);

  const label = range === '7d' ? 'Last 7 days' : range === '30d' ? 'Last 30 days' : 'Last 90 days';

  return (
    <div className="@container w-full">
      <div className="grid gap-4 @2xl:gap-6">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Overview</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Northwind Home store · {label}, up to 24 Nov 2026</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <SegmentedControl size="sm" value={range} onValueChange={(v) => setRange(v as Range)} aria-label="Date range">
              <SegmentedControlItem value="7d">7 days</SegmentedControlItem>
              <SegmentedControlItem value="30d">30 days</SegmentedControlItem>
              <SegmentedControlItem value="90d">90 days</SegmentedControlItem>
            </SegmentedControl>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
              <Icon name="download" />
              Export
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <StatGroup variant="shared" aria-label="Key metrics">
          <Kpi label="Revenue" value={money.format(view.revenue)} delta={view.deltas.revenue} series={view.spark.revenue} color="series-1" />
          <Kpi label="Orders" value={count.format(view.orderCount)} delta={view.deltas.orders} series={view.spark.orders} color="series-2" variant="bar" />
          <Kpi label="Visitors" value={count.format(view.visitors)} delta={view.deltas.visitors} series={view.spark.visitors} color="series-3" variant="line" />
          <Kpi
            label="Conversion rate"
            value={`${view.conversion.toFixed(2)}%`}
            delta={view.deltas.conversion}
            series={view.spark.conversion}
            color="series-4"
            variant="line"
          />
        </StatGroup>

        <div className="grid gap-4 @2xl:gap-6 @4xl:grid-cols-3">
          <Card className="min-w-0 @4xl:col-span-2">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Revenue</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Daily revenue against the previous {DAYS[range]} days</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <AreaChart
                data={view.trend}
                index="date"
                series={[
                  { key: 'current', label: 'This period', color: 'series-1' },
                  { key: 'previous', label: 'Previous period', color: 'var(--ui-muted-foreground)' },
                ]}
                indexFormat={day}
                valueFormat="currency"
                height={260}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card className="min-w-0">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Revenue by channel</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Where this period’s orders came from</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <BarChart
                data={view.channels}
                index="channel"
                orientation="horizontal"
                series={[{ key: 'revenue', label: 'Revenue', color: 'series-1' }]}
                valueFormat="currency"
                legend={false}
                height={260}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-4 @2xl:gap-6 @4xl:grid-cols-5">
          <Card className="min-w-0 @4xl:col-span-3">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Recent orders</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>{orders.length} orders in the last 8 days</CardDescription>
              <CardAction>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost">
                  View all
                  <Icon name="arrow-right" />
                </Button>
              </CardAction>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <DataTable
                columns={columns}
                data={orders}
                label="Recent orders"
                rowLabel="order"
                searchPlaceholder="Search orders"
                columnsMenu={false}
                defaultPageSize={5}
                pageSizeOptions={[5, 10]}
                defaultSort={{ id: 'date', direction: 'desc' }}
                compact
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card className="min-w-0 @4xl:col-span-2">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Activity</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>What happened in the store</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <Timeline aria-label="Store activity">
                {activity.map((a) => (
                  <TimelineItem key={a.title} tone={a.tone} marker={<Icon name={a.icon} />}>
                    <TimelineHeader>
                      <TimelineTitle>{a.title}</TimelineTitle>
                      <TimelineTime dateTime={a.time}>{a.at}</TimelineTime>
                    </TimelineHeader>
                    <TimelineDescription>{a.text}</TimelineDescription>
                  </TimelineItem>
                ))}
              </Timeline>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Sales and operations

File: `components/blocks/dashboard/sales.tsx` (docs source: `apps/docs/examples/blocks/dashboard/sales.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/ui/components/avatar';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/ui/components/card';
import { BarChart, DonutChart, RadialChart } from '@/ui/components/chart';
import { Progress } from '@/ui/components/progress';
import { Stat, StatDelta, StatGroup, StatHelp, StatLabel, StatValue } from '@/ui/components/stat';
import { SegmentedControl, SegmentedControlItem } from '@/ui/components/toggle-group';
import { UsageMeter } from '@/ui/components/usage-meter';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

type Region = 'all' | 'americas' | 'emea' | 'apac';

// Each region's share of the company numbers, and how far it is towards its quota
const REGIONS: Record<Region, { label: string; share: number; attainment: number; winRate: number }> = {
  all: { label: 'All regions', share: 1, attainment: 78, winRate: 31.4 },
  americas: { label: 'Americas', share: 0.47, attainment: 84, winRate: 33.9 },
  emea: { label: 'EMEA', share: 0.33, attainment: 73, winRate: 30.2 },
  apac: { label: 'APAC', share: 0.2, attainment: 69, winRate: 27.8 },
};

const QUOTA = 2_400_000;
const months = [
  { month: 'Jul', newBusiness: 412_000, expansion: 148_000 },
  { month: 'Aug', newBusiness: 386_000, expansion: 171_000 },
  { month: 'Sep', newBusiness: 455_000, expansion: 163_000 },
  { month: 'Oct', newBusiness: 498_000, expansion: 192_000 },
  { month: 'Nov', newBusiness: 531_000, expansion: 214_000 },
  { month: 'Dec', newBusiness: 284_000, expansion: 96_000 },
];
const plans = [
  { plan: 'Enterprise', arr: 6_840_000 },
  { plan: 'Business', arr: 3_920_000 },
  { plan: 'Team', arr: 1_760_000 },
  { plan: 'Starter', arr: 540_000 },
];
const reps: { name: string; initials: string; region: Exclude<Region, 'all'>; closed: number; quota: number }[] = [
  { name: 'Amina Rahman', initials: 'AR', region: 'emea', closed: 312_000, quota: 340_000 },
  { name: 'Diego Santos', initials: 'DS', region: 'americas', closed: 298_000, quota: 320_000 },
  { name: 'Grace Liu', initials: 'GL', region: 'apac', closed: 214_000, quota: 280_000 },
  { name: 'Marcus Bell', initials: 'MB', region: 'americas', closed: 256_000, quota: 320_000 },
  { name: 'Lena Vogel', initials: 'LV', region: 'emea', closed: 188_000, quota: 300_000 },
  { name: 'Kenji Mori', initials: 'KM', region: 'apac', closed: 141_000, quota: 240_000 },
];

const money = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
const compactMoney = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
  style: 'currency',
  currency: 'USD',
  notation: 'compact',
  maximumFractionDigits: 1,
});

export default function DashboardSales() {
  const [region, setRegion] = useState<Region>('all');
  const r = REGIONS[region];
  const scale = (n: number) => Math.round(n * r.share);

  const quota = scale(QUOTA);
  const closed = Math.round((quota * r.attainment) / 100);
  const commit = Math.round(quota * 0.12);
  const bestCase = Math.round(quota * 0.09);
  const pipeline = scale(5_860_000);
  const deals = Math.max(1, scale(214));
  const team = region === 'all' ? reps : reps.filter((rep) => rep.region === region);

  return (
    <div className="@container w-full">
      <div className="grid gap-4 @2xl:gap-6">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Sales</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Q4 2026 · 37 days left in the quarter</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <SegmentedControl size="sm" value={region} onValueChange={(v) => setRegion(v as Region)} aria-label="Region">
              <SegmentedControlItem value="all">All</SegmentedControlItem>
              <SegmentedControlItem value="americas">Americas</SegmentedControlItem>
              <SegmentedControlItem value="emea">EMEA</SegmentedControlItem>
              <SegmentedControlItem value="apac">APAC</SegmentedControlItem>
            </SegmentedControl>
            <Button size="sm">
              <Icon name="plus" />
              New deal
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <StatGroup aria-label={`Quarter to date, ${r.label}`}>
          <Stat>
            <StatLabel>Closed won</StatLabel>
            <StatValue>{money.format(closed)}</StatValue>
            <StatDelta value="18.2%" direction="up" comparison="vs Q3" />
            <StatHelp>{deals} deals this quarter</StatHelp>
          </Stat>
          <Stat>
            <StatLabel>Open pipeline</StatLabel>
            <StatValue>{compactMoney.format(pipeline)}</StatValue>
            <StatDelta value="6.5%" direction="up" comparison="vs Q3" />
            <StatHelp>2.4× the remaining quota</StatHelp>
          </Stat>
          <Stat>
            <StatLabel>Win rate</StatLabel>
            <StatValue>{r.winRate.toFixed(1)}%</StatValue>
            <StatDelta value="1.2 pts" direction="down" comparison="vs Q3" />
            <StatHelp>Deals closed won of all closed</StatHelp>
          </Stat>
          <Stat>
            <StatLabel>Sales cycle</StatLabel>
            <StatValue>34 days</StatValue>
            <StatDelta value="4 days" direction="down" tone="positive" comparison="vs Q3" />
            <StatHelp>Median, first call to signature</StatHelp>
          </Stat>
        </StatGroup>

        <div className="grid gap-4 @2xl:gap-6 @2xl:grid-cols-2 @5xl:grid-cols-3">
          <Card className="min-w-0">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Quota attainment</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>{r.label}, quarter to date</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <RadialChart
                variant="semicircle"
                data={[{ name: 'Attainment', value: r.attainment }]}
                index="name"
                valueKey="value"
                max={100}
                valueFormat="percent"
                centerLabel={`of ${compactMoney.format(quota)} quota`}
                legend={false}
                height={170}
              />
              <dl className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 border-t border-border pt-4 text-sm">
                {[
                  ['Closed', closed],
                  ['Commit', commit],
                  ['Best case', bestCase],
                ].map(([label, value]) => (
                  <div key={label} className="min-w-0">
                    <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt>
                    <dd className="mt-0.5 font-medium tabular-nums">{compactMoney.format(value as number)}</dd>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </dl>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="min-w-0">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>ARR by plan</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Annual recurring revenue, {r.label.toLowerCase()}</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <DonutChart
                data={plans.map((p) => ({ plan: p.plan, arr: scale(p.arr) }))}
                index="plan"
                valueKey="arr"
                centerLabel="Total ARR"
                valueFormat={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 }}
                height={240}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="min-w-0 @2xl:col-span-2 @5xl:col-span-1">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Plan usage</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Workspace limits on the Scale plan</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="grid gap-5">
              <UsageMeter
                label="API requests"
                value={8_620_000}
                max={10_000_000}
                formatValue={(n) => compactMoney.format(n).replace('$', '')}
                description="Resets on 1 December"
              />

              <UsageMeter label="Storage" value={412} max={1000} unit="GB" />
              <UsageMeter label="Build minutes" value={3120} max={6000} formatValue={(n) => n.toLocaleString('en-US')} />

            <CardFooter>

            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Bookings by month</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>New business and expansion, last 6 months</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <BarChart
                data={months.map((m) => ({ month: m.month, newBusiness: scale(m.newBusiness), expansion: scale(m.expansion) }))}
                index="month"
                series={[
                  { key: 'newBusiness', label: 'New business', color: 'series-1' },
                  { key: 'expansion', label: 'Expansion', color: 'series-2' },
                ]}
                stacked
                valueFormat="currency"
                height={260}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="min-w-0 @4xl:col-span-2">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Top reps</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Closed won against personal quota</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <ul className="grid gap-4" aria-label="Top reps">
                {team.map((rep) => {
                  const pct = Math.round((rep.closed / rep.quota) * 100);
                  return (
                    <li key={rep.name} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <Avatar size="sm">
                        <AvatarFallback>{rep.initials}</AvatarFallback>
                      </Avatar>
                      <div className="grid min-w-0 flex-1 gap-1.5">
                        <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2 text-sm">
                          <span className="truncate font-medium">{rep.name}</span>
                          <span className="flex-none tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                            {compactMoney.format(rep.closed)} · {pct}%
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <Progress
                          value={pct}
                          size="sm"
                          tone={pct >= 90 ? 'success' : 'default'}
                          aria-label={`${rep.name}, ${pct}% of quota`}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ul>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```
